description_en: Schedules simulated system events for one or more ECS instances. Simulated system events are equivalent to event drills. They do not actually execute events or affect ECS instances
description_zh: 为一台或多台ECS实例预约模拟系统事件。模拟系统事件相当于事件演习，不会真正执行事件，也不会对ECS实例产生影响
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-simulated-system-events --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-type SystemMaintenance.Reboot --not-before 2018-12-01T06:32:31Z --instance-id i-bp1gtjxuuvwj17zr0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSimulatedSystemEvents

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the system event. Valid values: 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to system maintenance.
SystemFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to a system error.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error.
SystemMaintenance.Stop: The instance is stopped due to system maintenance.
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to system maintenance.
SystemFailure.Redeploy: The instance is redeployed due to a system error.
SystemFailure.Stop: The instance is stopped due to a system error.
InstanceFailure.Reboot: The instance is restarted due to an instance error
parameters.help_zh:
系统事件的类型。取值范围： 

SystemMaintenance.Reboot：因系统维护实例重启。
SystemFailure.Reboot：因系统错误实例重启。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启。
SystemMaintenance.Stop：因系统维护实例停止。
SystemMaintenance.Redeploy：因系统维护实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Redeploy：因系统错误实例重新部署。
SystemFailure.Stop：因系统错误实例重新停止。
InstanceFailure.Reboot：因实例错误实例重启
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled start time of the event. The time follows the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in UTC+0 and is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

For abnormal events caused by system errors or instance errors, the event is in the Executing state immediately after it is created. In this case, the NotBefore parameter indicates the time when the event transitions to the Executed state
parameters.help_zh:
事件计划执行的开始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

对于系统错误或实例错误导致的异常事件，创建事件后，事件已处于正在执行（`Executing`）状态，此时参数`NotBefore`为事件进入完成执行（`Executed`）状态的时间
parameters.name: not_before

parameters.help_en: The list of ECS instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID列表信息。可输入最多100个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_zh:
是否触发真实运维操作。取值范围：
- true：触发真实运维，系统将真实执行实例的停机或释放操作，需要谨慎测试，或选择无业务的实例进行测试。。
- false（默认值）：仅模拟事件通知，不影响实例实际生命周期
parameters.name: trigger_real_ops
